song_story.overview: Closed Ending is about the specific stuck feeling of knowing exactly how a relationship ends and still not being able to actually end it. The two people in the song sit facing each other, not making eye contact, cycling through the same unresolved conversation over and over — the narrator says outright that no matter how many times you rewrite the last chapter, it's already been written, and yet the song itself keeps circling back to it instead of closing the book.
song_story.cultural_root: The central image is 마지막 장 (the last chapter/page) being 'already written down' — the relationship's ending treated like a fixed, unchangeable text rather than something still being decided. This connects to 미련 (miryeon), the specifically Korean concept of lingering attachment that keeps you from fully letting go even after you intellectually accept something is over. The song's quiet devastation comes from knowing the ending and still not being able to close it — 미련 winning out over acceptance, even briefly.

verse_1.lines: 마주 안자 우리는maju anja urineun / 다른 곳을 바라보곤 해dareun goseul barabogon hae / 답을 모른 채dabeul moreun chae / 같은 얘기를 반복하게 돼gateun yaegireul banbokage dwae / 다시 써 내려가도dasi sseo naeryeogado / 우리의 마지막 장은uriui majimak jang-eun / 필 수 없는 다잖은 endingpil su eomneun dajaneun ending / 그때 그 순간들geuttae geu sun-gandeul / 꼭 꿈만 같아kkok kkumman gata / 바래 지지 않은barae jiji aneun / 우리의 시간uriui sigan / 수많은 계절의sumaneun gyejeorui / 흔적을 지나heunjeogeul jina / 여기 남은 건yeogi nameun geon
verse_1.literal: We sit facing each other / and end up looking at different places / not knowing the answer / we end up repeating the same conversation
verse_1.context: 마주 앉다 (to sit facing each other) followed immediately by looking away sets up the whole song's central contradiction — physical closeness with total emotional distance. -곤 하다 marks a repeated habit, meaning this isn't a one-time argument, it's a loop they keep falling into.

chorus.lines: 아련함만aryeonhamman / 그 언젠가 한 번쯤 들어봤던geu eonjen-ga han beonjjeum deureobwatdeon / 식상한 사랑의 마지막 가틀 걸siksanghan sarang-ui majimak gateul geol / 잘 알면서도 끝내 덮지를 못해jal almyeonseodo kkeunnae deopjireul motae / 너를neoreul / 마주 안자 우리는maju anja urineun / 다른 곳을 바라보곤 해dareun goseul barabogon hae / 답을 모른 채dabeul moreun chae / 같은 얘기를 반복하게 돼gateun yaegireul banbokage dwae / 다시 써 내려가도dasi sseo naeryeogado / 우리의 마지막 장은uriui majimak jang-eun / 필 수 없는 다잖은 endingpil su eomneun dajaneun ending / 다시 써 내려가도dasi sseo naeryeogado / 우리의 마지막 장은uriui majimak jang-eun
chorus.literal: Even if we write it out again / our last chapter is / already written down / an ending we can't stop, that's just how it is
chorus.context: 다시 써 내려가도 (even if [we] write it out again) admits they keep trying to rewrite the story anyway, despite it not changing anything. The mix of English ('already written down') with Korean reinforces the sense of something fixed and outside their control — almost like the ending exists in a language neither of them can edit.

verse_2.lines: 필 수 없는 다잖은 endingpil su eomneun dajaneun ending / 나란히 걷던 길naranhi geotdeon gil / 혼자 걸으면honja georeumyeon / 지그시 발피는jigeusi balpineun / 어제들만eojedeulman / 멈춰버린 시계와meomchwobeorin sigyewa / 대답 없는 봄daedap eomneun bom / 온종일 기다려도onjong-il gidaryeodo / 바꿔지 않아bakkwoji ana / 내 가슴을 스치는 오랜 기억nae gaseumeul seuchineun oraen gieok / 그 종잎이 유난히 아플 때면geu jong-ipi yunanhi apeul ttaemyeon / 눈을 감아도 더욱 선명해지는nuneul gamado deouk seonmyeonghaejineun / 모습moseup / 마주 안자 우리는maju anja urineun
verse_2.literal: Those moments back then / feel just like a dream / our time / that hasn't faded / passing through the traces / of so many seasons / what's left here / is only a wistful ache
verse_2.context: 바래 지지 않은 (that hasn't faded) sits in tension with 수많은 계절 (countless seasons) passing — enough time has gone by that it should have faded, but hasn't. 아련함 (a soft, wistful ache, closer to bittersweet longing than sharp pain) is the specific emotional register the whole song lives in.

bridge.lines: 다른 곳을 바라보곤 해dareun goseul barabogon hae / 답을 모른 채dabeul moreun chae / 같은 얘기를 반복하게 돼gateun yaegireul banbokage dwae / 다시 써 내려가도dasi sseo naeryeogado / 우리의 마지막 장은uriui majimak jang-eun / 필 수 없는 다잖은 endingpil su eomneun dajaneun ending / 마지막 장을 남겨놓은 내 마음majimak jang-eul namgyeonoeun nae ma-eum / 다 알고 있어도 말을 수 없는 다음da algo isseodo mareul su eomneun da-eum / 지울 수 없도록 여기 깊이 새겨진jiul su eopdorok yeogi gipi saegyeojin / 이젠 바꿀 수 없는ijen bakkul su eomneun / 우리의 마지막 장은uriui majimak jang-eun / 필 수 없는 다잖은 endingpil su eomneun dajaneun ending / 다시 써 내려가도dasi sseo naeryeogado / 우리의 마지막 장은uriui majimak jang-eun / 필 수 없는 다잖은 endingpil su eomneun dajaneun ending
bridge.literal: Something I probably heard somewhere before / a clichéd, typical ending to a love story, I bet / even knowing that well, I still can't finally close the book / on you
bridge.context: 식상하다 (clichéd, stale, overused) is her own honest assessment of the situation — she knows this is an ordinary heartbreak story, nothing special about it, and that self-awareness doesn't make it any easier to close. 덮다 (to close/cover, as in closing a book) makes the metaphor of the relationship as a written story literal — she can't physically close the cover even knowing how it ends.

artist_context: SHAUN is a Korean singer-songwriter known for a mellow, soulful pop-R&B sound, who found major international breakout success with Way Back Home. Closed Ending sits within his catalog of introspective, downtempo material that favors quiet emotional resolution over dramatic heartbreak.
honorific_level: informal — 반말 throughout, subdued and resigned

grammar_highlights.usage: Marks a repeated, habitual action. 바라보곤 해 ('we end up looking [away]') signals this is a recurring pattern in the relationship, not a single moment.
'Even if.' 다시 써 내려가도 ('even if we write it again') concedes an action while stating it won't change the outcome — the core grammar of futility running through the whole song.
Emphatic form of -지 못하다 (unable to do something), with 를 adding weight to the failure. 덮지를 못해 ('I just can't close it') stresses how stuck the inability is, beyond a simple 못 덮어.
